subject: otel-genai-semconv-proposal-text

metrics.proposal: gen_ai.eval.* semantic convention attributes for signed/attested eval events
attributes: gen_ai.eval.card_id — sha256 of signed measurement card
gen_ai.eval.merkle_root — root the card is included in
gen_ai.eval.corrections_count — number of published corrections for this card
gen_ai.eval.verification_url — URL where stranger can verify
metrics.rationale: No current OTel convention covers signed/attested eval events. CSOAI 22-axis instrument operates at scale (335+ signed cards, 257-leaf Merkle root). Observability vendors (Honeycomb, Datadog, Grafana) watch this repo.
metrics.use_case: AI eval platform emits signed measurement card → OTel collector captures gen_ai.eval.* attributes → downstream tools (Datadog, Honeycomb) display verified measurements, not raw eval scores.

honest_sentence: OTel GenAI semconv proposal: add 7 new gen_ai.eval.* attributes (card_id, issuer_did, merkle_root, timestamp_authority, signature, corrections_count, verification_url). No current convention covers signed/attested eval events. Observability vendors watch this repo.
